node_7.subject: Li Mingzhu
node_7.description: This is Li Mingzhu's plan for Sunday February 15: wake up and complete the morning routine at 8:00 am, prepare the tea house and open for the morning shift at 8:30 am, serve breakfast and morning tea to early customers from 8:30 to 11:00 am, visit the market to purchase fresh pastries and lantern supplies from 11:00 am to 1:00 pm, from 1:00 to 4:00 pm, take a brief rest and change into festive clothing from 4:00 to 5:00 pm, personally invite familiar neighbors and regular customers who pass by to attend the evening gathering, from 5:00 to 6:30 pm, open the tea house for the Lantern Festival evening gathering at 6:30 pm, serve tea and sweet cakes to guests, light the lanterns, and enjoy the festival atmosphere with customers until 10:00 pm, close the tea house, clean up, and count the day's earnings from 10:00 to 11:00 pm.
